name: Rend Mind (3 Energy Dice)
desc: You expend three Psionic Energy Dice to use Rend Mind again: after Sneak Attack damage with your Psychic Blades, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + Dex modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or has the Stunned condition for 1 minute (it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns).
